caption: The drawing consists of thin, black outline lines on an off-white or light beige background. Near the center is the profile outline of a dog sitting upright, facing left, rendered with a single unbroken line. Overlapping the dog’s outline are two geometric forms constructed from straight and curved lines: a vertical rectangle with a circular hole near the top, positioned in the center, and two elliptical rings—one near the neck area and another near the base, both seen in perspective to form ovals. The lower oval intersects with a horizontal cylinder that sits at the base of the drawing, also outlined in black. The lines of the shapes overlap with the silhouette of the dog without filling or shading. There are a few small, sparse brownish spots on the paper, likely from age or staining. The overall composition is simple, with the largest forms occupying the central and lower portions of the page, and significant empty space around them.
title: Umbrella Stand
